fields.name: 佩佩
fields.love: 小粒特芙、大粒特芙、南方风味特芙、欧加斯特芙、南洋冒险奇谭、教职员事件簿、斗技场物语的抄本、商贸入门、女骑士与求婚者、庶民百景、加了特芙的烤点心、营养满分点心书、药草料理大全、幽·法丝的肖像、“盾”的肖像画、飞马的风景画
fields.like: 芙朵拉红茶、桌上游戏定式集、鲜红赤烧、关节保护用长手套、小猫摆设、简易魔术道具、野外用厨具、浅色绘画材料、精灵护身人偶、尖锐的鱼钩、精灵桌上游戏、耐用的皮革背包、丹提戏曲全集、锻炼用石柱、武术训练用重物

fields.q: 这里的人一天比一天更爱戴朕。这就是王者对他人的影响吗？
fields.en: More of the people here grow to love us by the day. Is this the effect kings have on others?
fields.name: 佩佩

q.value: 这里的人一天比一天更爱戴朕。这就是王者对他人的影响吗？

en.value: More of the people here grow to love us by the day. Is this the effect kings have on others?

fields.q: 朕此刻有些无聊。你会表演什么把戏吗？
fields.en: We find ourselves bored at the moment. Can you perform any tricks?
fields.name: 佩佩

q.value: 朕此刻有些无聊。你会表演什么把戏吗？

en.value: We find ourselves bored at the moment. Can you perform any tricks?

fields.q: 朕自幼便爱吃海鲜，想与你一同品尝鞑古扎的特产。
fields.en: We have enjoyed seafood since our earliest days and would like to savor Dagdan specialties with you.
fields.name: 佩佩

q.value: 朕自幼便爱吃海鲜，想与你一同品尝鞑古扎的特产。

en.value: We have enjoyed seafood since our earliest days and would like to savor Dagdan specialties with you.

fields.q: 朕来自热爱自然的布丽吉德王国，所以和你在一起很愉快。
fields.en: We are from Brigid, which is a kingdom that loves nature. So we enjoy our time with you.
fields.name: 佩佩

q.value: 朕来自热爱自然的布丽吉德王国，所以和你在一起很愉快。

en.value: We are from Brigid, which is a kingdom that loves nature. So we enjoy our time with you.

fields.q: 朕认为你值得朕庇护，若你遇到麻烦，就交给朕吧。
fields.en: We deem you worthy of our protection, so if you're ever in trouble, please let us handle it.
fields.name: 佩佩

q.value: 朕认为你值得朕庇护，若你遇到麻烦，就交给朕吧。

en.value: We deem you worthy of our protection, so if you're ever in trouble, please let us handle it.

fields.q: 你一定要来朕的王国。朕会隆重地款待你！
fields.en: You must visit our kingdom. We would feed and entertain you magnificently!
fields.name: 佩佩

q.value: 你一定要来朕的王国。朕会隆重地款待你！

en.value: You must visit our kingdom. We would feed and entertain you magnificently!

fields.q: 朕非常喜爱布丽吉德的子民。若你见到，务必告诉朕，好吗？
fields.en: We are very fond of the people of Brigid. So if you see any, please tell us, alright?
fields.name: 佩佩

q.value: 朕非常喜爱布丽吉德的子民。若你见到，务必告诉朕，好吗？

en.value: We are very fond of the people of Brigid. So if you see any, please tell us, alright?

fields.q: 你让朕想起故乡的精灵。也许我们之间有某种联系。
fields.en: You remind us of the spirits of our homeland. Perhaps we are connected somehow.
fields.name: 佩佩

q.value: 你让朕想起故乡的精灵。也许我们之间有某种联系。

en.value: You remind us of the spirits of our homeland. Perhaps we are connected somehow.

fields.q: 要了解异国的风俗，没有比和当地人打成一片更好的办法了，对吧？
fields.en: To learn the ways of a foreign land, there's no better way than to mingle with its people, right?
fields.name: 佩佩
